name: kongono/security
description: Kongono v1 standalone PHP 8.5 security & passwordless auth primitives: HKDF XChaCha20-Poly1305 Encryptor, Argon2id PasswordHasher, RFC 6238 Totp + pure-PHP ISO/IEC 18004 QrCodeSvg, cryptographic QrLoginAuth, OneTimeCodeAuth (Email/SMS OTP), MagicLinkAuth, WebAuthn PasskeyVerifier (ES256/Ed25519), PKCE OAuth, PersonalAccessToken, HTML5 Lexbor HtmlSanitizer, WebhookSigner, and SSRF-pinned SafeHttpClient.

suggest.kongono/database: Required only when using PdoPersonalAccessTokenStore for SQL-backed Personal Access Tokens.
suggest.kongono/http: Required only when using SessionAuth, RememberMeManager, Gate HTTP exceptions, or Kongono PSR-15 security middleware.
